title: X canonical URL caused full LLM regeneration
reproduction: A source begins as /i/status/<id> and acquisition resolves it to /<author>/status/<id>.
impact: The same valid director manifest was regenerated, adding 22 LLM calls and avoidable cost.

title: Missing browser text aborted an otherwise valid render
reproduction: A source page changes DOM text after the director selected an exact evidence target.
impact: Capture failed instead of preserving the source page with an honest non-highlighted fallback.

title: GitHub placeholder description became a fake browser target
reproduction: The GitHub API returns the literal placeholder 'No repository description'.
impact: The recorder searched for text that was never visible on the repository page.

title: Launchd lock contention was recorded as a pipeline crash
reproduction: A scheduled launch overlaps a still-running manual or launchd pipeline.
impact: A healthy no-op collision polluted the bug audit as a crash.

title: Sensitive research review could be confused with publication approval
reproduction: A security-research video reaches the dashboard with only the editorial safety gate blocked.
impact: One click could ambiguously mean both safety review and publication authorization.

title: Model video title named the publisher but omitted the model
reproduction: A repair shortens a model hook by dropping GLM-5.3-Flash while retaining OrcaRouter.
impact: Viewers cannot identify which model the metrics describe.

title: Specialist metric was not explained for vibe coders
reproduction: The hook says refusal rate or rejection rate with a percentage but never defines the metric.
impact: A technically curious non-research audience sees numbers without understanding what they measure.

title: Long exact titles risked losing entities instead of adapting layout
reproduction: A title needs the exact model name plus a quantified hook and exceeds the default two-line rail.
impact: Copy repair could remove the subject to fit instead of preserving meaning.

title: YouTube output could contain silent or truncated audio
reproduction: A rendered collection item fails AAC, audio duration, or audible-audio validation.
impact: A video could look complete while losing the original speech after the opening minutes.

title: Tiny browser highlight aborted deterministic rendering
reproduction: A valid source target such as License: produces a yellow outline narrower than the readable-line gate.
impact: A valid content manifest failed rendering even though the page position itself was useful evidence.

title: Selected glossary definition was stored but invisible on X card
reproduction: The root X shot carries a glossary definition in audience_copy while the card renders only full_translation.
impact: The manifest passed readability checks but the viewer never saw the promised explanation.

title: YouTube interview highlight downloaded the complete source before selection
reproduction: Generate a 60–180 second known-tech interview highlight from a 15–120 minute YouTube source.
impact: The factory downloaded the entire source before transcript selection, wasting bandwidth, time, storage, and retry cost.

title: X acquisition hid OpenCLI exit diagnostics
reproduction: The same OpenCLI X command succeeds directly but exits 69 when the Video Factory subprocess lacks browser automation access.
impact: The job reported only CalledProcessError, so operators could not distinguish a browser permission boundary from a bad URL or missing post.

title: Editorial agent stopped after a cheap model exhausted semantic repairs
reproduction: The primary low-cost writer produces three near-duplicate retention hooks and the independent copy critic rejects every bounded repair.
impact: A valid source required Codex intervention even though a stronger qualified model was available through a configured fallback provider; an explicit primary-provider choice incorrectly disabled that route.

title: LLM retry multiplication allowed one logical call to block for six minutes
reproduction: A provider returns empty or invalid content while each of three transport attempts waits for the former 120-second timeout.
impact: A 12-call primary plus 14-call fallback path could take many minutes without local CPU work or visible progress.

title: Temporal wording still implied an explicitly unproven causal link
reproduction: Evidence says an account was suspended after a configuration change and the author explicitly says they do not know whether the setup triggered it.
impact: Short-video copy such as '照做后被封' was likely to be read as causation even after replacing the stronger word '导致'.

title: Employee reply was promoted to an official company response
reproduction: A company employee replies from a personal X account inside a public discussion thread.
impact: Viewer-facing copy called the personal comment the company's first official response, overstating source identity and authority.

title: WeChat playback chrome covered the fixed title and conclusion rails
reproduction: View a 1080x1920 information-frame video full-screen in WeChat Channels on a phone with status chrome and the post-title/action overlay visible.
impact: The first title line overflowed beneath the top status area and the fixed conclusion collided with the WeChat post title, making essential copy unreadable.

title: WeChat publisher silently left the original-content declaration unchecked
reproduction: Submit a Tencent/WeChat Channels video through the pinned social-auto-upload runtime and inspect the original-content checkbox before the final publish click.
impact: The publisher reported success without applying the creator's required original-content declaration.

title: Expired WeChat cookie was misclassified as an uncertain submission
reproduction: Let Tencent upload-video reject an expired cookie before constructing the uploader after a stale preflight check reported valid.
impact: A definitely safe pre-submit failure became non-retryable, forcing manual batch repair and delaying publication.

title: One WeChat publish attempt opened the creator page four times
reproduction: Run an approved Tencent publish batch and count browser launches from batch preflight, CLI setup, uploader validation, and the real upload page.
impact: Redundant login probes slowed every publish, confused the operator, and repeatedly rotated the WeChat session cookie.

title: Normal video mastering ran a redundant MoneyPrinterTurbo render before FFmpeg
reproduction: Render an editorial or GitHub video and inspect the mastering path after the native visual track is complete.
impact: Every job paid for an unnecessary external Python render and inherited its task-directory, placeholder-timing, and subprocess failure modes even though FFmpeg rebuilt the final output from the original native visual.

title: Capture stopped when optional web-scroll-video patch markers changed
reproduction: Format or upgrade the pinned web-scroll-video runner so one exact source marker used by the padded-runner patch no longer matches.
impact: A cosmetic integration patch became a single point of failure and required Codex to repair the dependency adapter before any video could be produced.

title: Default Chinese font resolved to one developer's MoneyPrinterTurbo checkout
reproduction: Run composition outside /Users/clairehou/pyProjects without setting VIDEO_FACTORY_FONT.
impact: Rendering failed on otherwise valid macOS, Linux, Windows, CI, or container installations even when a Chinese-capable system font was available.

title: Equal shot timing ignored visible text density
reproduction: Generate a BGM-only story whose evidence shots all receive the same duration even though one screen contains several times more visible Chinese and technical text than another.
impact: Dense evidence disappeared before viewers could finish reading it, while sparse shots consumed the same amount of the fixed runtime. The persistent upper hook and lower conclusion are intentional and remain pinned.

title: Experimental Radar styling silently replaced the stable compositor
reproduction: Load an archived manifest after adding expanded layouts, glass glosses, crop zoom, badges, and camera motion directly to the default render path.
impact: Every existing video changed at once, making regressions indistinguishable from intentional redesign and removing the known-good rollback path.

title: Radar effects had no bounded render fallback
reproduction: A platform FFmpeg build rejects the focus-crop or animated transition filter graph.
impact: A cosmetic enhancement could abort the entire agent instead of returning a readable stable video and recording the degraded path.

title: Retention prompt forced conflict when a direct fact was the better opening
reproduction: Generate a short for a strong technical announcement whose evidence contains no honest incumbent conflict or surprising comparison.
impact: The writer could manufacture drama, competitor framing, or ROI instead of quickly reporting what happened.

title: Radar density routing crashed on the first real capture
reproduction: Frame an archived OpenRouter capture with radar_v2 so the compositor classifies a highlighted price-table shot.
impact: The renderer raised NameError before FFmpeg because density matching depended on an unimported regular-expression module.

title: Radar identifier badge covered the first evidence lines
reproduction: Inspect the first OpenRouter Radar frame with a category pill and long model identifier at the top of the evidence pane.
impact: The badge overlapped the page headline and price proof, reducing readability while trying to add navigation metadata.

title: Hugging Face thumbnail URL became a fake model identifier
reproduction: Render a model story whose archived image URL under /social-thumbnails/models appears before the actual Hugging Face repository URL.
impact: The on-screen direct badge displayed HF: social-thumbnails/models instead of the real owner/model path.

title: Empty Radar metadata rail reduced evidence height
reproduction: Render a tweet story such as Jeff Dean or Sam Altman with no package, repository, model identifier, or factual category label.
impact: The compositor still reserved 88 pixels and drew a link-only badge, adding noise while shrinking the real evidence pane.

title: External visual critic retried failing media payloads without a bounded fallback ladder
reproduction: Send four videos to an AI Studio app, retry the same internal error, split to two videos, then encounter a paid-key requirement in the multimodal playground.
impact: A production agent could loop on a broken session, repeatedly upload the same assets, or implicitly cross a billing boundary instead of degrading safely and asking for authorization.

title: Developer artifact extraction discarded type and provenance
reproduction: Extract a package, model, container, or repository identifier for the Radar metadata rail and receive only a presentation string.
impact: Adding new ecosystems required more display-oriented regex patches, while downstream validation could not distinguish artifact kind or trace the source used for the badge.
